author: Zavaluxx
quote:
Finally the game has released and I beat the game! What did I think?

First off what a Boring Story, I'm so annoyed I waited 13 years for a game that simulates doing chores, working boring jobs and prirotizes this woke world we live in. Driving between missions is not great because you drive so long and have to listen to the two main characters have boring pointless conversations all the time. Like when Lucia talks to the Robot Voice in the car that was not a needed conversation. Apparently there is a random event where you cant carjack women specifically because they have a mental breakdown and it stops you from doing Grand Theft Auto. You also cant kill whoever you want, you cant do what you want the game should of been called GTA IV FOLLOW THE RULES. I am glad they included the LGBTQ+ community but you cant kill any of them, are there exceptions for anyone else? They seem a little bit on the favorite train.... The game also feels sort of rushed so they could try to get into the game awards this year. Also excuse me the game running at 30fps is visually sickening, when I rotate my camera around why does it look like the game drops to 12 fps for a few moments? All I would need is a bit of screen tearing and it would be fantabulous. You cant kill who you want to kill, it really feels like the game is on guided rails at many moments. I wanted to be dropped into the world of GTA for a chance for me to let loose but its like they wanted to make a real life simulator in a game. No thanks I can do real life simulator, in REAL LIFE for FREE. Talk about an overhyped trash game, and then they didnt even include PC so I guess forget about them? 

I like how its like no one remembers how the previous game released WITHOUT online play initially and how Negatively that was recieved by the player base. Then when we got multiplayer the launch was abysmal filled with no one being able to get online, what you wanna bet its going to happen again? We already got the barebones totally forgetful story, now its time to get the mack daddy of horrible online service launches. I do not understand how Rockstar went from GTA V to whatever GTA VI is supposed to be. The car customization feels limited, why are there only 4 to 5 colors for a car, why do i have to drive across the town to fill my gas tank and even further to modify my car, why cant i do it all in one spot like the previous game? Also the cars are all the same it really does look like a copy past for the most part, but a little bit of originality would of been cool just sayin. The sheer DISTANCE between some of the missions is also really bad it really feels like iRacing at points more than a GTA game. If you crash well that ****, get another car but hope to god you dont get blocked by that random chance encounter.

Then the controls, are they responsive? Yes? Better feeling than the last GTA games? Yes well mostly? How hard is it to drive in a straight line? It varies, because a small misinput will put you into the wall at mach jesus, ejecting yourself crushing your car and making it overall really easy to spin your tires. The gunplay is fine, that is what the 1 is for, feels similar to RDR2 in that aspect. 

Finally we were promised a bigger map, a more detailed and emmersive world and we got it, but wrapped up in all of that is a trash abysmal story, with forgettable characters, terrible voice acting, limited car customization, woke lifestyles, job and chores simulator, boring driving simulator, gym simulator and to top it all off I do not know who wrote Lucia's character but that person needs fired ASAP, I almost quit the game all together because of how annoying and poorly written she is. The game get a well deserved 1/10 if it wins GOTY we will all know for certain that the Choice Awards are 100% rigged. 

Tell me how the Critic Score is 99 at the time of writing this and the User Rating is 5.4, sounds like paid reviews to me baby, done and done.
